s1.desc: a sunny beach scene with turquoise water and smooth ice rocks on the sand

s2.desc: a room drawn on a plain pale grey background

s3.desc: a picnic spot on an icy clifftop above the sea

spans.notes: 11 frames of push-in at the start of the beach shot (ECC on the lower sand band scale 1.008 at f3, 1.022 at f9; full-res pixel changes stop after f11). Also a camera_move

spans.view: with the sun and fluffy clouds in the sky behind them

beats.text: Pax holds up a lilac seashell while Polly lowers her raised flipper with her eyes closed
Pax holds the seashell out to Polly and she takes it in both flippers
Polly holds the seashell to her chest, smiling at it, while Pax stands with his eyes closed and a proud smile

spans.notes: camera locked f11-46: lower sand band ECC constant from f12 (scale 1.0257 vs f0 = the end of the push-in), full-res pixel changes 0 from f12; compare 11/46 rocks and shoreline black. Waves and clouds animate. No caption or watermark

spans.view: with a desk holding a rounded computer monitor and keyboard, a shell-backed stool and a tall stack of papers

beats.text: Pax stands beside Polly's stool holding a small bouquet of orange flowers while Polly sits at the computer desk
Pax holds the bouquet up to Polly and she reaches out and takes it
Polly holds the bouquet up to her beak and sniffs it, blinking, while Pax closes his eyes and blushes beside her
Polly smells the bouquet with her eyes closed and a smile while Pax stands beside her blushing with his eyes shut

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 47/90 shows black edges on the monitor, desk, papers and stool; full-res monitor region 0 changed pixels f47-90 (ECC on the top band wobbles within 0.5% only because Polly's head is in it). No caption or watermark | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v07): beat [67,91): Polly's eyes are open f67-71 and f76-77 (closed only f72-75 and from f78); Pax's eyes are still open f67-68

spans.view: with a coral picnic blanket, a picnic basket and a flask, and the sea and a low sun behind them

beats.text: Pax sits on the blanket holding a black instant-photo gadget up at arm's length for a selfie while Polly leans in and winks
Pax keeps the gadget raised as a small paper print slides out of its top, Polly leaning against him
Pax lowers the gadget to his lap and Polly takes the print from it
Polly holds up the blank print and peers at it with rosy cheeks and raised brows while Pax leans close, looking at it too

spans.notes: camera locked: lower cliff band ECC scale 1.0000, 0 px through f135; compare 91/135 cliff, blanket and basket black. Only the clouds drift (the top band ECC reads +0.9 px/frame sideways from them). The print stays blank (zoomed f133), so no lead depiction. A small flash sparkle at f95-97. No caption or watermark | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v07): beat [123,136): Pax is not smiling; he leans in looking at the print with wide eyes and an open beak, and Polly peers at it with raised, puzzled brows

Polly flops on a bed then sits up holding a small box: static only f136-154 (19 frames), then a push-in f155-167 (lower bed band ECC scale 1.006 at f157, 1.024 at f166). Neither part reaches 21 frames

insert: an open memory box labelled with the leads' names seen from above; only Polly's flipper reaches in to drop in a shell, flowers, letters, a small penguin plush and photos. The photos show Pax and Polly (also lead_copy) and the label is in-world text
